title: Introducing Prooflane
voice: Prooflane checks router and firewall settings, flags security risks, and shows the evidence behind every finding. Here is how it works.

title: One network. Many languages.
voice: Different vendors use different configuration languages. Reviewing them by hand makes security problems easy to miss.

title: Snapshot to assessment.
voice: Upload saved device settings. Add the device type, software version and file completeness. Choose a security checklist, then start the audit.

title: Show me the evidence.
voice: In this sample, line five uses an old version of secure remote access, SSH. The rule requires version two. Prooflane flags the mismatch and suggests a fix for human review.

title: Unknown is a useful answer.
voice: Missing or conflicting evidence stays unknown. The coverage bar shows how much could actually be checked.

title: Inspect. Explain. Export.
voice: Inspect findings beside the original settings, compare what was found with what was expected, and download a shareable report.

title: Unfamiliar syntax? Build understanding.
voice: When a format is unfamiliar, Gemini consults approved references and asks questions. It proposes a rule for reading that format. Tests and a human reviewer must approve it before use.

title: New understanding. Preserved history.
voice: Approved reading rules work without a code deployment. Every audit keeps its original input and rule versions, even when later rules change.

title: Follow the audit in 3D.
voice: Explore the audit in three dimensions. Select any stage to see the recorded evidence behind it.

title: Built for accountable processing.
voice: The interface sends audits to background workers. A database keeps their history. Encrypted storage protects files. Access is controlled by role. Optional AI helps investigate unfamiliar formats.

title: Clear scope. Demonstrated resilience.
voice: Twenty checks cover selected Cisco, Junos and FortiOS settings. Synthetic tests covered sustained load and recovery. Standards crosswalks support review; they do not certify compliance.

title: Trace the finding. Trust the evidence.
voice: Prooflane. Trace the finding. Trust the evidence.
